flora: Brachyphyllum (conifer with short, overlapping scale-like leaves)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; foliage should look like braided green cords; avoid needle-like pine textures; emphasize the geometric, scale-like pattern of the branches; rounded, chunky woody stems.

visual_logic.composition: A mid-range shot of a Brachyphyllum bush leaning over a limestone ledge. The scale-covered branches droop slightly toward a turquoise lagoon in the background.
visual_logic.ground: Fine golden sand with embedded fossilized shell fragments and sun-bleached limestone slabs.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, tropical high-noon sun creating high contrast between the dark green scales and the pale rock.
